purpose: Parameter-sensitivity follow-up of a diagnosed retention tradeoff, NOT a new method or hardware admission
selection: CA_CLASS_REPAIR from exploratorychecks02, equivalent to R2 with static translation retention disabled; fixed before this sensitivity run
population: Within each setting, fixed ordinary+R2 completed cases. New failures invalidate the ablation's primary population mean; do not substitute survivors.
questions: Does the exploratory sync gain versus R2 repeat across assumed coupling/noise settings? What tracking cost and ordinary-BLNN gap remain?
interpretation: These are uncalibrated assumed-model sensitivity settings, not independent physical validation. Removing an old rule is an ablation/rollback, not itself a new innovation. No hardware release, including if all settings improve against R2. Latest paper sync-benefit claim must also be evaluated against ordinary BLNN.
